audit.whatIsWrong: Both chart layers gave Volibear Levels 2 through first item, contradicting the packet chart, the whys text and spikes[0], which all call Levels 3-5 Illaoi's window.
audit.why: Illaoi wins 56.24%. Test of Spirit reaches 900; Thundering Smash only closes from 300 on a 12s rank-1 cooldown.
audit.corrected: L1 Volibear, L2 through Levels 4-5 Illaoi, Level 6 Volibear (Stormbringer), first item Illaoi, 2+ items skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was attributed to a shield on Stormbringer. Stormbringer grants bonus health; the shield is Sky Splitter (E).
audit.why: Riot's R text: 'leaps to a target location, Slowing and damaging enemies beneath him while gaining bonus Health.' Riot's E text: 'granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius.'
audit.corrected: spikes[1], whys[4] and mid rewritten: Stormbringer is a 550-range leap on 160/135/110s that grants bonus health and disables your tower; the shield belongs to a 1200-range E on a flat 16s cooldown and only applies when he stands in his own blast.

audit.whatIsWrong: Thundering Smash was described as a root in three places; it is a stun. Frenzied Maul was called 'Frenzy (W)' in three places.
audit.why: Riot's Q text says 'Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks'. The W's real name is Frenzied Maul, and its second cast on the same target heals him and applies on-hit effects.
audit.corrected: Names and CC type fixed. Added the decisive range picture — E 900 against a 300-range Q — and the anti-heal timing: Frenzied Maul's repeat cast is the heal, so Grievous Wounds goes on before extended trades, not after.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was listed in report[8] but never explained in the content layer, and on-hit scaling was never mentioned.
audit.why: _missing carries needs-antiheal and onhit-itemization for this matchup. Frenzied Maul applies on-hit effects, so his damage scales with attack speed stacked by The Relentless Storm — armour alone misreads the trade.
suspectNames flagged 'Thundering Smash', 'Test of Spirit' and 'Stormbringer' — all three are the correct Riot names. False positives.

audit.whatIsWrong: _missing carries enemy-dash-deniable: 'Your Leap of Faith (R) shuts off Volibear's Stormbringer (R)'.
audit.why: That rule derives from a 'grounding' flag on Illaoi's R, but Riot's own description of Leap of Faith mentions only damage and a tentacle per champion hit — no grounding. Per the brief, the description wins over a contradicting derived flag.
audit.corrected: Not written. Recorded as unverified instead of shipping a claim that would have a player hold a 120s ultimate to deny a leap it may not deny.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 dip back to Voli as his Frenzy and base power spike.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay yours: his Q closes from only 300 and is down 11s.

edits.before: Stormbringer's shield lets him tank your R all-in at level 6.
edits.after: Stormbringer's bonus health lets him tank your all-in at level 6.

edits.before: Your window: land Test of Spirit (E) and W (Harsh Lesson) onto Volibear before his Frenzy stacks build. His Thundering Smash (Q) root only lands if he closes, so space it, then E-tether and unload tentacles — his early sustain from passive can't cover a full tentacle proc when you hit E first.
edits.after: Your window: Test of Spirit (E) reaches 900 while Thundering Smash (Q) only closes from 300 and is down 12s at rank 1 — and it stuns, it does not root. Space the walk-up, E him, then Harsh Lesson (W) every 4s and let the tentacles work before Frenzied Maul (W) heals it all back.

edits.before: Volibear's Stormbringer (R) grants a shield, bonus HP, and empowered attacks, letting him tank your Leap of Faith (R) burst and all-in through your tentacle field. Don't R into his R — bait it or wait it out, then commit when his ult and Q are down.
edits.after: Stormbringer (R) is a 550-range leap that hands him bonus health and disables your tower, and it is down 160s at rank 1 — the longest cooldown in the lane. The shield is Sky Splitter (E), not his ult. Don't trade ults: wait his out, then commit.

edits.before: Back to your favour: with your first item and a landed E, your tentacle damage out-trades his bruiser build before he's fully online. Keep him off CS with max-range Q and only fight on your tether.
edits.after: Back to your favour: with your first item and a landed E your tentacles out-trade him — but Frenzied Maul (W) applies on-hit and its second cast on the same target heals him, so buy Executioner's Calling before the extended trades.

edits.before: Roughly even/skill — Volibear's R engage, Q root, and W (Frenzy) burst let him pick fights, but your tentacle field is huge in teamfights when he dives your backline. Trade blows around his ult cooldown and group with your team.
edits.after: Roughly even: his R engage, Q stun and Frenzied Maul (W) burst let him pick fights, but your field punishes him for leaping your backline. Sky Splitter (E) reaches 1200 and only shields him if he stands in his own blast — punish the ones he throws from range.

edits.before: Volibear wins L1-2: his passive sustain and beefy base stats shrug your early Q poke, and with no E yet you can't pin him. Farm and avoid his Q-root walk-ups.
edits.after: Volibear wins L1: The Relentless Storm stacks attack speed the longer he swings, and with no Test of Spirit yet you cannot pin him. Farm, and never stand inside 300 range.

edits.before: L3-5 you take over — a landed Test of Spirit (E) glues him and W-into-tentacles out-trades his Frenzy (W) stacks before he's built. The one bump is around his level 5-6 power, and at 6 his Stormbringer (R) shield and empowered attacks let him tank your Leap of Faith all-in, so bait the ult first.
edits.after: L2-5 you take over: Test of Spirit (E) reaches 900 against a 300-range Thundering Smash on a 12s cooldown, and Harsh Lesson resets every 4s onto the spirit. Level 6 is his bump — Stormbringer (R) leaps 550 and grants bonus health, so wait out its 160s rather than trading ults with him.

edits.before: After your first item your tentacle damage on a tethered Voli wins again, then it settles toward a skill matchup: he engages with R and Q-root, you answer with your tentacle field in teamfights. Fight around his ult cooldown and don't R into his R.
edits.after: After your first item your tentacles win again, then it settles into a skill fight: he engages with R and the Q stun, you answer with the field. Fight on his ult cooldown, keep Grievous Wounds up against Frenzied Maul, and don't R into his R.

edits.before: Land Test of Spirit (E) before Volibear stacks Frenzy
edits.after: Land Test of Spirit (E) from 900, outside his 300-range Q

edits.before: Close with Thundering Smash (Q) root to start the trade
edits.after: Close with Thundering Smash (Q) stun to start the trade

edits.before: Use Frenzy (W) burst to spike short trades
edits.after: Use Frenzied Maul (W) to spike short trades

notes: Corrected a real mechanical error: the page credited Stormbringer with a shield. Riot's text gives Stormbringer bonus health and gives the shield to Sky Splitter (E), and only when Volibear stands in his own blast. Also fixed root/stun on Thundering Smash and the fabricated ability name 'Frenzy (W)' (Frenzied Maul). Did NOT write the _missing claim that Leap of Faith grounds Stormbringer — that rule comes from a grounding flag Riot's own R description does not support.
